scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a large building with a Burger King sign in front of it. The building has a mix of orange and tan colors and is several stories tall. There are cars parked along the side of the street and a few pedestrians walking around. A man wearing a backpack walks away from the camera towards the building. }
scene_analysis.materials: The building's facade is made of stone and has a mix of orange and tan colors. There are several windows on each floor. The building has a flat roof. There are several other buildings in the background. The sky is overcast.
